alba · the revamped look

Prototype for issue #55, as locked. Every shot is the real alba binary with the fixture data (Buenos Aires), offline. Click a shot to enlarge it.

The ladder

alba takes the first rung that fits the pane. C, the week as a column, where there is room; U, the week under the readings, where C does not fit. The week never sits beside the clock. The sparkline shows only with its label, in the large rungs; the smaller rungs show the condition instead. Below the ladder, v1's mini and one-line sizes. Ghostty, dark terminal, the terminal theme.

Themes

terminal, the default, uses only the terminal's named colors: the strong accent is bold text, the second accent is red, and yellow stays in the pictures, because yellow text fades on light themes. dark and warm fill the pane with their own colors.

Icons

24-bit half-block icons where the terminal has 24-bit color; v1's icons elsewhere. Fog: a cloud over drifting mist. Thunder: the cloud flashes twice and the bolt shows for a second and a half of every eight seconds.

macOS Terminal

The terminal theme in Terminal. Terminal draws half blocks from the font, so seams split each pixel row.

The prototype's bar

Keys: h theme, t/T time ±1h, c condition, b bar. It shows the theme, the rung, the time, and the condition.
